label: Places to the Right
subgoals: Each place to the right of the decimal point is one tenth of the place before it.
A zero in a place still matters for the value of the digits around it, even though it adds nothing to the digit sum.

label: Value of a Digit
subgoals: The value of a digit is the digit multiplied by the value of its place.
The same digit has different values in different positions.
Expanded form writes a number as the sum of these place values.

label: Reading and Writing
subgoals: Read the whole part, then the decimal part as a single number named by its last place.
When writing from words, count the places named by the final word and fill any gaps with zeros.
Aligning decimal points makes addition, subtraction and comparison reliable.
